Linear Actuator



LACT-12 - 12" Linear Actuator
     (Length: 17-1/2" retracted to 29-1/2" extended in 21 sec.)
LACT-10 - 10" Linear Actuator
     (Length: 15-1/2" retracted to 25-1/2" extended in 17 sec)
LACT-8 - 8" Linear Actuator
     (Length: 13-1/2" retracted to 21-1/2" extended in 13 sec)
LACT-6 - 6" Linear Actuator
     (Length: 11-1/2" retracted to 17-1/2" extended in 10 sec)

Linear actuators (LACT series) provide 110 lbs of pulling and pushing force and come in 6", 8", 10"  and 12" lengths to accommodate a variety of uses. The LACT actuators can be used in applications from lifting trunk lids and tonneau covers, amplifier racks, compartment covers and storage drawers. Each unit has built in limit switches and comes complete with machined aluminum mounting brackets, control switch and wiring harness.

For simpler and safer use, add a PAC-3100 single linear actuator controller, or the PAC-3200 to operate a pair of actuators moving the same direction.  Linear actuator controllers provide three preset positions for one-touch access, trigger input wires for remote control access, and a safety reverse functions in case of blocked travel.

Mounting Plate Dimensions:
1-1/8" x 1-1/2"W
